thread:
alex_cs: Quick heads-up  Kestrel Analytics renewal came in — they want to shorten to 9 months and attach a PO that requires a vendor code and specific billing entity name. Their CSM mentioned onboarding still has 2 items outstanding (SSO and data ingest). They said payments blocked unless PO matches their vendor code policy.

rachel_sales: FYI i've been pushing their procurement. they say their AP team won't issue a PO without exact vendor name and code. asked if we can accept a provisional PO and then replace once final. also asked if we can do a partial invoice to unblock onboarding.

tom_legal: We can support provisional PO + amendment, but need explicit approval language on the provisional doc. I'll prepare an amendment template and an "interim acceptance" clause that allows invoice issuance pending final PO. Need to know which billing entity they require.

ben_finance: We can bill against a provisional PO if we have written approval from an authorized approver (email from an @kestrel domain + procurement-bot ticket). Wire is acceptable as fallback. For partial invoice, recommend 40% upfront to cover initial services.

maya_enablement: Onboarding impact: we currently have kickoff scheduled Friday. If payment is delayed more than 48h, we risk postponing the hands-on workshop. I'll offer a recorded SSO walkthrough and hold a short live session regardless if they commit to the partial invoice. That should keep momentum.

alex_cs: Action items: 1) @rachel_sales confirm exact vendor name/code asap. 2) @tom_legal draft provisional PO clause + 9mo amendment. 3) @ben_finance prepare partial invoice and wire instructions. 4) @maya_enablement prep 30-minute recorded SSO guide + contingency live slot. I'll notify customer.

rachel_sales: Just asked procurement again, cc'd their AP lead. I suggested "VendorCode: KA-4412" as placeholder. i also asked if their approver can email acceptance to billing@redwood.com to satisfy finance.

procurement-bot: Ticket PR-KA-4412 created for Kestrel vendor-code request. Status: pending. SLA: 72 hours.

tom_legal: Draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/kestrel/9mo-interim-amendment (restricted). Key line: "Customer authorizes Redwood to issue an interim invoice against a provisional PO pending final PO issuance; final PO must be provided within 30 days or funds credited." Please review wording on 9mo proration.

ben_finance: Partial invoice template attached in thread (PDF). Banking: Redwood Inc. acct ****6789, SWIFT: REDWUS33. For partial, we'll do 40% now, remainder invoiced pro rata over term. Note: if approver email comes from non-standard alias, we need a procurement-bot ticket + recorded call confirmation.

maya_enablement: Blocked Thursday 3-5pm as contingency for live SSO session. i'll record a 12-min SSO walkthrough and send beforehand. Also compiling checklist for their infra team to fill so we don't waste the live slot.

alex_cs: Update from customer: they can issue a provisional PO with the placeholder vendor code but insist the vendor code appears in the PO number field. They emailed approver (approver@kestrel.com) giving permission for interim billing. I forwarded to @ben_finance.

rachel_sales: they also asked about price adjustment for 9mo vs 12mo. they're expecting a small discount for shorter commitment. sent them our standard proration + term discount table. awaiting response.

tom_legal: fine on pricing approach. I'll add a line in the amendment that any term-discount calc is final only once PO is finalized. helps avoid circularity.

ben_finance: Received approver email and provisional PO PDF. Preparing invoice now and will send with wire + CC options. tagging repayment terms in memo. Sending now.

maya_enablement: Sent recording and checklist link to customer: https://share.redwood/kestrel/sso-guide. Confirmed live slot is reserved contingent on partial payment.

alex_cs: Great work. Current risk: medium. If PO finalizes within 72h we keep onboarding and avoid revenue delay. If not, we push to AM for exec assist. I'll keep thread updated and will close when amendment signed and final PO in drive. :white_check_mark:
